Priya (AM): Kicking off Relicon POC. They need SSO (SAML) + SCIM bulk import + RBAC mapping. On-prem option required for prod. Can we confirm major blockers and a pricing approach? Meeting Thurs to decide.
Aisha (SE): For SCIM: they want to import ~500k users and keep group->role mapping. Any advice on rate limits/chunking? Also will they need delta syncs?
Tom (Eng): We can handle 500k but recommend chunked imports with concurrency 8-16 and exponential backoff. For delta syncs use incremental timestamps + efficient diffing. Example curl for bulk: ```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Bulk -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @bulk.json
```
Tom (Eng): For on-prem production: two options — customer-managed air-gapped package (we ship a tarball + install guide) or Private (VPC) with management plane access. KMS/HSM integration is non-trivial.
Eli (Infra): @Priya for on-prem we need a network diagram + host/IP allowlist. If they want support with no control plane access, ops will require a signed SOW. Also: what's their DR expectation?
Priya (AM): I'll ask for the diagram. Also need committed QPS numbers — they expect ~200 TPS peaks during business hours. How does that change Dedicated vs Hosted recommendations?
Josh (SE): 200 TPS peak pushes toward Dedicated/reserved capacity. Ballpark: 2 reserved nodes for steady state plus burst pool. I'll calc a preliminary daily cost and margin. Also confirm if they want automatic fallback to Hosted on overload.
Aisha (SE): They also sent a security questionnaire asking about SOC2, data residency, audit logs, and KMS. Sharing our standard sec pack: https://redwood.example.com/sec/pack.pdf
Eli (Infra): KMS look: we can integrate with customer KMS (cross-account IAM role) or HSM. Key rotation and offline backup policies need legal review; also for on-prem HSM we'll need physical certs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: provisioning task prod-onprem-provisioner created -> status: waiting for IP allowlist (owner: infra-team)
Priya (AM): Action items: (1) Priya to collect network diagram + SSO metadata + QPS cert; (2) Tom to draft SCIM import recipe + backoff params and attach example configs; (3) Josh to produce pricing estimate with Dedicated + fallback to Hosted options; (4) Aisha to return security pack answers. Sync Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
Aisha (SE): Quick SCIM patch example for adding members:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "add",
    "path": "members",
    "value": [{ "value": "user-123" }]
  }]
}
```
Tom (Eng): Note on RBAC mapping: we support (A) SCIM groups -> roles for initial imports and periodic syncs, and (B) SAML assertion-based roles for realtime access control. Recommend SAML assertions for enforcement and SCIM for bootstrap.
Priya (AM): Thanks everyone — I'll collect docs and post the security questionnaire link to Relicon. If they insist on fully air-gapped with zero management plane, flag for CSM/legal for a bespoke support SOW. Sync Tue.
